discription: A basic pulse wave synth with a resonant low-pass filter and ADSR envelope, with added pan control.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, pan=0; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.3, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, 0.5); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, freq * 2, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; sig = Pan2.ar(sig, pan); Out.ar(out, sig); }
